hooks.command: command -v graft >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "The Graft plugin is enabled but graft is not installed, so nothing is recorded. Install it: npm install -g @fourshore/graft"; exit 0; }; v="$(graft --version 2>/dev/null)"; case "$v" in 0.0.*|0.1.*) echo "The Graft plugin needs graft 0.2.0 or newer and found $v, so nothing is recorded. Update it: npm install -g @fourshore/graft@latest";; esac
command -v graft >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; graft hook claude-code --plugin 2>/dev/null || exit 0
